titles.title: PCSF00001
titles.name: Uncharted: Golden Abyss
toGameplay: opening film: skip it after at most 40 s
Tutorial: Journal (start of the Prologue): tap the icon-bar tab at the bottom right (see the screen below)
gameplay: the icon bar sits on the right edge (camera, journal, table of contents, the tab that shows or hides it)

screens.title: PCSC00045
screens.after: main menu 新しいシングルプレイ → 兵士
screens.expects: the thumb held still on the front touch panel, in the centre of the scan rectangle, until the scan completes (it is not a shader compilation or a loading screen)
screens.notes: 4.5 s of holding is not enough; without any touch the screen moves on by itself after ~110 s

screens.title: PCSF00001
screens.after: the opening film, when the Prologue's gameplay starts (a real Vita shows it there too with Tutorial Hints on)
screens.expects: a touch on the icon-bar tab at the bottom right of the screen, the icon under the lined-paper one ("Touch to bring up the ICON bar..."); the game is paused meanwhile and buttons, the book icon, the lined paper (table of contents) and touches elsewhere do not close it
screens.result: the tutorial closes and the Prologue's gameplay goes on
screens.notes: the tab spans about x 0.93-0.99, y 0.72-0.84 (re-runs of a capture: taps at 0.93,0.72 / 0.95,0.75 / 0.965,0.78 / 0.98,0.80 close it at once; 0.96,0.915 below it does not). Android with the on-screen controls on: the right stick's circle covers the left two thirds of the tab on a 20:9 phone, so tap its right edge (x 0.98) or turn the on-screen controls off in the pause menu first
